critical_code_review_comments: ape.py router had ObjectId leak: after motor's insert_one, the _id ObjectId is mutated into the dict and was returned via _enrich_ape causing 500. FIXED by popping _id.
_enrich_ape in ape.py was overriding stato='sostituito' with stato calculated from data_scadenza. This caused list/get APIs to mislabel substituted APEs as 'valido'. FIXED to preserve sostituito.
ai.py PUT /config: defaults uses ollama_url='http://ollama:11434' but env says 'http://localhost:11434'. Minor inconsistency.

ai.py POST /chat line 144: model resolution uses ternary that always returns 'external_model' (string literal), not the actual config value. Should be: config.get('ollama_model') if provider == 'ollama' else config.get('external_model'). Currently passes literal 'external_model' as model when not ollama. Cosmetic - doesn't break flow.
ape.py POST /ape and /upload: marks ALL previous APE as sostituito BEFORE inserting new one - if insert fails after, old APEs stay incorrectly marked. Should be transactional or post-insert.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (APE, AI, Impostazioni pages all working; /verbali/nuovo skeleton issue)
